page.layout: One printed page, a single woodcut device in the centre; no text blocks. The only words are the banner inside the oval: "LABORE ET CONSTANTIA", set on a curved ribbon.
page.notes: Title-page device: a woodcut border with two allegorical figures (a warrior at left, a standing female figure at right), a winged figure/eagle at top corners, a central oval containing a pair of compasses, a sprig and an elephant or beast motif, and a banner reading "LABORE ET CONSTANTIA". Only the banner carries printed words. The lower centre shows a small face or mask. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is legible.
